tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Read-only search for activities by location/query/date. Each result includes `booking_link`, `thumbnail_url`, `group_size`, and a standardized `item_card`.

tools.name: get_complementary_recommendation
tools.description: Read-only ranked complementary activities anchored to a source product_id. Each recommendation includes `booking_link`, `thumbnail_url`, and a standardized `item_card`.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_activity_details" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
